review_method: Ordinary source/text/JSON reads and AST parsing only. No reviewed module or test was imported or executed.

concrete_core_findings.source_witness: bridge.run_audio_pipeline starts volume_observer with critical=False and all three streams DEVNULL, then initializes upstream=None before iterating pipeline_commands.
concrete_core_findings.conclusion: Observer is not connected to the linear media pipe. Diagnostic media roles remain capture,input_meter,convert,output_meter,player; default roles remain capture,convert,player.

concrete_core_findings.source_witness: supervisor.start defaults critical=True; optional input_from is forbidden; optional spawn exceptions return None with fixed class/status. wait and cleanup_boundary only attribute critical natural nonzero exits to audio failure. Teardown iterates all owned children/process groups/handles.
concrete_core_findings.conclusion: Missing or failed observer can be nonfatal to the audio pipeline; unreaped optional processes/groups or failed handle cleanup remain cleanup failure. Bridge records process start/returncode separately from volume_observer_data_verified=false.

concrete_core_findings.source_witness: bridge.main returns from plan-conversion and offline-only before importing dbus or reading private configuration. Observer top-level imports are standard-library only; TraceProvider is selected before LiveProvider construction.
concrete_core_findings.conclusion: Reviewed offline/plan paths do not construct live providers. Review itself issued no queries.

concrete_core_findings.source_witness: LiveProvider reads two bounded private configuration files, validates address literals and unique Garmin, constructs exact Device selectors, then calls only GetManagedObjects(timeout=...) on org.bluealsa.phone and org.bluealsa. select_candidates also requires A2DP-sink/source or HFP-AG/sink and holds duplicates.
concrete_core_findings.conclusion: No PCM Open, property Set, SelectCodec, pairing, connection, phonebook, or playback API is present in observer. Live provider construction and actual D-Bus timing are untested by this review.

concrete_core_findings.source_witness: sanitize_pcm_properties uses an explicit wrapper-class map before casts; decode_properties requires integer uint16 Volume, one/two Channels, actual boolean SoftVolume when present, and known codec tokens. Channel 1 uses high byte; channel 2 uses low byte; mute bit7 and gain bits0..6; mono omits channel 2 without requiring its unused byte to be zero.
concrete_core_findings.conclusion: Arbitrary string false does not become a boolean. Unknown codec text becomes other. SoftVolume and Codec can be absent and their absence is not proof of a false control state.

concrete_core_findings.source_witness: Meter records read_begin/read_end/forward_end plus monotonic row time and optional run token. Observer stamps after read_snapshot, which sequentially obtains two role snapshots.
concrete_core_findings.conclusion: Intervals include host read waits and forwarding. Neither row timestamps nor shared run tokens establish sample capture, acoustic time, a common boot, atomic metadata sampling, resampled content alignment, or Bluetooth packet loss.

concrete_core_findings.source_witness: Observer BoundedWriter creates a new nofollow file mode0600, limits output to1MiB with1024B final-summary reserve and bounded rows; fixed states replace exception payloads. SIGTERM sets a stop event, collect finishes summary, and main returns0 for backend/output loss.
concrete_core_findings.conclusion: Ordinary backend unavailability is nonfatal. Output creation refusal returns2, handled as optional by supervisor. Disk failure or interruption may leave incomplete data; start/exit0 alone does not prove a final summary or complete samples.

issues: parse_volume did not read actual observer events_written/events_dropped/polls/output_cap_reached; real cap-drop completeness could be missed.
safe_volume rejected a nonzero unused mono low byte even though observer test01 explicitly accepts mono0xc2ff.
safe_volume required SoftVolume despite observer allowing it to be absent; role-specific gain<=15 guard also exceeded observer typed schema.
Cross-file monotonic binding used sets of present run IDs/clock kinds, allowing rows missing the run or monotonic value to coexist with a true binding label.
Several set-membership operations on unvalidated stop_reason/role/error_kind could raise TypeError for JSON list/dict values outside main's fixed DataError path.

closed_guards: mono unused-byte interpretation separated from channel controls
optional metadata availability separated from control changes
garmin gain outside0..15 remains held protocol interpretation
all rows need supplied run and monotonic values for declared cross-file binding
safe scalar membership and fixed malformed-shape CLI errors
bounded integer/numeric checks and nonfinite ratio hold
correction_review.whole_source_identity_limit: Final whole source SHA and unchanged-AST completeness inherit owner pins; no final whole-source reread or target execution by reviewer.

evidence_limits: Meter is an opt-in inline PCM tee and its statistics/report writes can add processing latency; observer alone is outside the PCM chain.

Existing private debug stderr, supervisor repr strings and legacy pipeline evidence are not claimed deidentified or globally bounded. New scalar observer output and analyzer public output are separate contracts.
Generic repeated optional start failures are not globally capped by supervisor; the reviewed bridge has one fixed optional role.
No live backend query, phone packet, current sound, native App/A2DP/ownership/STOP_DONE, or hardware acceptance was proved.
